tool_args.content:
# Literature Map for Agent Progress Probe (EMNLP 2026 ARR)
# Generated: 2026-05-14
# Paper: Temporal Label Model for Progress Stagnation Detection in LLM Agents
#
# Novelty check result: "temporal label model" as a general-purpose extension
# of data programming to sequential data appears NOVEL. Closest works are
# Safranchik AAAI 2020 (NER-specific linked HMM) and Sala NeurIPS 2019
# (multi-resolution WS, not temporal transitions).

papers:

  # ============================================================
  # CATEGORY: direct-competitor
  # ============================================================

  - id: "xi2025agentprm"
    title: "AgentPRM: Process Reward Models for LLM Agents via Step-Wise Promise and Progress"
    authors: "Zhiheng Xi, Chenyang Liao, Guanyu Li, Yajie Yang, Wenxiang Chen, Zhihao Zhang, Binghai Wang, Senjie Jin, Yuhao Zhou, Jian Guan, Wei Wu, Tao Ji, Tao Gui, Qi Zhang, Xuanjing Huang"
    venue: "arXiv preprint"
    year: 2025
    arxiv: "2511.08325"
    category: "direct-competitor"
    role: "主要竞争者：step-level PRM for agent guidance"
    key_finding: "用 promise（长期潜力）和 progress（即时进展）两个维度评估 agent 每步决策，实现 8x 计算效率提升"
    our_differentiation: "我们是 window-level monitoring（不是 step-level guidance），不需要 outcome labels，目标是 stagnation detection 不是 reward shaping"

  - id: "choudhury2025prm"
    title: "Process Reward Models for LLM Agents: Practical Framework and Directions"
    authors: "Sanjiban Choudhury"
    venue: "arXiv preprint"
    year: 2025
    arxiv: "2502.10325"
    category: "direct-competitor"
    role: "PRM 框架综述 + InversePRM 方法"
    key_finding: "提出 AgentPRM（Monte Carlo rollout actor-critic）和 InversePRM（从 demonstrations 学习 process reward），3B 模型超越 GPT-4o"
    our_differentiation: "InversePRM 仍需 demonstration trajectories，我们用 programmatic LFs 替代人工标注；我们关注 monitoring 而非 training signal"

  - id: "li2026toolprmbench"
    title: "ToolPRMBench: Evaluating and Advancing Process Reward Models for Tool-using Agents"
    authors: "Dawei Li, Yuguang Yao, Zhen Tan, Huan Liu, Ruocheng Guo"
    venue: "arXiv preprint"
    year: 2026
    arxiv: "2601.12294"
    category: "direct-competitor"
    role: "Tool-use PRM 评测基准"
    key_finding: "大规模 benchmark 评测 PRM 在 tool-use 场景的效果，发现专用 PRM 显著优于通用 PRM"
    our_differentiation: "我们的 TLM 是 unsupervised（不需要 step-level reward labels），且关注 stagnation pattern 而非 step correctness"

  - id: "wang2026planrewardbench"
    title: "Aligning Agents via Planning: A Benchmark for Trajectory-Level Reward Modeling"
    authors: "Jiaxuan Wang, Yulan Hu, Wenjin Yang, Zheng Pan, Xin Li, Lan-Zhe Guo"
    venue: "arXiv preprint"
    year: 2026
    arxiv: "2604.08178"
    category: "direct-competitor"
    role: "Trajectory-level reward model 评测"
    key_finding: "所有 reward model 类别（generative, discriminative, LLM-as-Judge）在长 horizon trajectory 上性能显著下降"
    our_differentiation: "验证了长 trajectory 评估的难度——我们的 window-level 方法通过局部化避免了这个问题"

  - id: "chen2025monitoring"
    title: "Monitoring LLM Agents for Sequentially Contextual Harm"
    authors: "Yueh-Han Chen, Neelay Joshi, Yulin Chen, He He, Rico Angell"
    venue: "ICLR 2025 Workshop on Building Trust in Language Models and Applications"
    year: 2025
    arxiv: null
    openreview: "LC0XQ6ufbr"
    category: "direct-competitor"
    role: "Agent monitoring 安全方向"
    key_finding: "将有害任务分解为单独无害的子任务可将 refusal rate 从 50% 降至 10%，现有 monitor 难以检测 sequentially contextual harm"
    our_differentiation: "他们关注 safety monitoring（harmful behavior），我们关注 progress monitoring（stagnation）；互补方向"

  - id: "kale2025weaktostrong"
    title: "Reliable Weak-to-Strong Monitoring of LLM Agents"
    authors: "Neil Kale, Chen Bo Calvin Zhang, Kevin Zhu, Ankit Aich, Paula Rodriguez, Scale Red Team, Christina Q. Knight, Zifan Wang"
    venue: "arXiv preprint"
    year: 2025
    arxiv: "2508.19461"
    category: "direct-competitor"
    role: "Weak-to-strong agent monitoring 方法论"
    key_finding: "Monitor scaffolding 比 monitor 能力更重要，弱模型可以可靠监控强模型；targeted human-in-the-loop 提升 TPR ~15%"
    our_differentiation: "他们用 LLM 作为 monitor，我们用 structural LFs + TLM，不依赖另一个 LLM；我们的方法更轻量且可解释"

  # ============================================================
  # CATEGORY: method-component
  # ============================================================

  - id: "ratner2016dataprogramming"
    title: "Data Programming: Creating Large Training Sets, Quickly"
    authors: "Alexander Ratner, Christopher De Sa, Sen Wu, Daniel Selsam, Christopher Re"
    venue: "NeurIPS 2016"
    year: 2016
    arxiv: "1605.07723"
    category: "method-component"
    role: "核心方法论基础：data programming 范式"
    key_finding: "用户编写 labeling functions（噪声启发式），generative model 学习 LF 准确率生成概率训练标签"
    our_differentiation: "我们扩展 data programming 到时序数据，加入 temporal transition structure"

  - id: "ratner2017snorkel"
    title: "Snorkel: Rapid Training Data Creation with Weak Supervision"
    authors: "Alexander Ratner, Stephen H. Bach, Henry Ehrenberg, Jason Fries, Sen Wu, Christopher Re"
    venue: "VLDB 2018"
    year: 2018
    arxiv: "1711.10160"
    category: "method-component"
    role: "Data programming 系统实现，label model 基础"
    key_finding: "端到端弱监督系统：LFs → generative label model（建模 LF dependency）→ discriminative end model"
    our_differentiation: "Snorkel 假设数据点 i.i.d.，我们的 TLM 显式建模相邻 window 间的 label transition"

  - id: "fu2020flyingsquid"
    title: "Fast and Three-rious: Speeding Up Weak Supervision with Triplet Methods"
    authors: "Daniel Y. Fu, Mayee F. Chen, Frederic Sala, Sarah M. Hooper, Kayvon Fatahalian, Christopher Re"
    venue: "ICML 2020"
    year: 2020
    arxiv: "2002.11955"
    category: "method-component"
    role: "快速 label model，triplet method of moments"
    key_finding: "用 triplet method 闭式求解 label model 参数，比 SGD 快 170x"
    our_differentiation: "FlyingSquid 同样假设 i.i.d.；我们的 TLM 需要不同的参数估计方法来处理时序依赖"

  - id: "zhang2021wrench"
    title: "WRENCH: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Weak Supervision"
    authors: "Jieyu Zhang, Yue Yu, Yinghao Li, Yujing Wang, Yaming Yang, Mao Yang, Alexander Ratner"
    venue: "NeurIPS 2021 Datasets and Benchmarks Track"
    year: 2021
    arxiv: "2109.11377"
    category: "method-component"
    role: "弱监督评测基准"
    key_finding: "22 个真实数据集 + 120+ 方法变体评测，标准化弱监督研究"
    our_differentiation: "WRENCH 数据集全是 i.i.d. 分类/序列标注，没有 temporal stagnation detection 任务"

  - id: "safranchik2020linkedhmm"
    title: "Weakly Supervised Sequence Tagging from Noisy Rules"
    authors: "Esteban Safranchik, Shiying Luo, Stephen H. Bach"
    venue: "AAAI 2020"
    year: 2020
    arxiv: null
    category: "method-component"
    role: "最近的方法论前驱：linked HMM for sequence tagging weak supervision"
    key_finding: "将 HMM 引入弱监督序列标注（NER），加入 linking rules 建模 span 结构，比 i.i.d. label model +7 F1"
    our_differentiation: "他们是 token-level NER（BIO 约束），我们是 window-level temporal classification；我们建模的是 stagnation temporal dynamics 而非 entity boundary"

  - id: "sala2019multiresolution"
    title: "Multi-Resolution Weak Supervision for Sequential Data"
    authors: "Frederic Sala, Paroma Varma, Jason Fries, Daniel Y. Fu, Stefano Sagawa, Christopher Re"
    venue: "NeurIPS 2019"
    year: 2019
    arxiv: "1910.09505"
    category: "method-component"
    role: "最近的方法论前驱：multi-resolution WS for sequential data"
    key_finding: "处理不同时间分辨率的 LFs（如 frame-level vs span-level），建模 multi-resolution LF correlations"
    our_differentiation: "他们关注 resolution mismatch，我们关注 temporal label transitions；互补视角"

  - id: "dawid1979em"
    title: "Maximum Likelihood Estimation of Observer Error-Rates Using the EM Algorithm"
    authors: "A. P. Dawid, A. M. Skene"
    venue: "Journal of the Royal Statistical Society, Series C"
    year: 1979
    arxiv: null
    category: "method-component"
    role: "Label aggregation 奠基工作"
    key_finding: "用 EM 算法估计标注者混淆矩阵，无需 ground truth"
    our_differentiation: "经典 i.i.d. 假设；我们的 TLM 可视为 temporal extension of Dawid-Skene for programmatic LFs"

  - id: "nguyen2017hmmcrowd"
    title: "Aggregating and Predicting Sequence Labels from Crowd Annotations"
    authors: "An Thanh Nguyen, Byron C. Wallace, Junyi Jessy Li, Ani Nenkova, Matthew Lease"
    venue: "ACL 2017"
    year: 2017
    arxiv: null
    category: "method-component"
    role: "HMM + crowdsourcing label aggregation"
    key_finding: "HMM-Crowd：扩展 Dawid-Skene 到序列数据，加入 one-step Markov structure over true labels"
    our_differentiation: "他们用于 crowdsourcing（人类标注者），我们用于 programmatic LFs（自动化）；他们是 NER/IE，我们是 agent progress monitoring"

  # ============================================================
  # CATEGORY: evaluation
  # ============================================================

  - id: "orlanski2026slopcodebench"
    title: "SlopCodeBench: Benchmarking How Coding Agents Degrade Over Long-Horizon Iterative Tasks"
    authors: "Gabriel Orlanski, Devjeet Roy, Alexander Yun, Changho Shin, Alex Gu, Albert Ge, Dyah Adila, Nicholas Roberts, Frederic Sala, Aws Albarghouthi"
    venue: "arXiv preprint"
    year: 2026
    arxiv: "2603.24755"
    category: "evaluation"
    role: "Agent degradation 基准——直接支持我们的 problem motivation"
    key_finding: "Agent 代码质量在迭代任务中持续退化：比人类代码 2.3x 更冗余、2.0x 更结构侵蚀，75-77% trajectory 呈现退化趋势"
    our_differentiation: "SlopCodeBench 量化了 degradation 现象，我们提供了检测方法；他们是 post-hoc 评测，我们是 online monitoring"

  - id: "jimenez2024swebench"
    title: "SWE-bench: Can Language Models Resolve Real-World GitHub Issues?"
    authors: "Carlos E. Jimenez, John Yang, Alexander Wettig, Shunyu Yao, Kexin Pei, Ofir Press, Karthik Narasimhan"
    venue: "ICLR 2024"
    year: 2024
    arxiv: "2310.06770"
    category: "evaluation"
    role: "Agent 数据来源之一"
    key_finding: "2294 个真实 GitHub issue 任务，标准化 agent 评测"
    our_differentiation: "我们使用 SWE-bench agent trajectories 作为实验数据源之一"

  - id: "yang2024sweagent"
    title: "SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering"
    authors: "John Yang, Carlos E. Jimenez, Alexander Wettig, Kilian Lieret, Shunyu Yao, Karthik Narasimhan, Ofir Press"
    venue: "NeurIPS 2024"
    year: 2024
    arxiv: "2405.15793"
    category: "evaluation"
    role: "Agent 系统——trajectory 数据来源"
    key_finding: "提出 agent-computer interface (ACI)，GPT-4 Turbo 在 SWE-bench 达 12.47% resolve rate"
    our_differentiation: "SWE-agent trajectories 是我们分析 stagnation 的数据来源之一"

  - id: "wang2025openhands"
    title: "OpenHands: An Open Platform for AI Software Developers as Generalist Agents"
    authors: "Xingyao Wang, Boxuan Li, Yufan Song, Frank F. Xu, Xiangru Tang, et al."
    venue: "ICLR 2025"
    year: 2025
    arxiv: "2407.16741"
    category: "evaluation"
    role: "Agent 平台——主要数据来源"
    key_finding: "开源 agent 平台，sandbox 执行环境，15+ benchmarks 评测"
    our_differentiation: "OpenHands trajectories 是我们的主要实验数据来源"

  # ============================================================
  # CATEGORY: background
  # ============================================================

  - id: "shinn2023reflexion"
    title: "Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning"
    authors: "Noah Shinn, Federico Cassano, Ashwin Gopinath, Karthik Narasimhan, Shunyu Yao"
    venue: "NeurIPS 2023"
    year: 2023
    arxiv: "2303.11366"
    category: "background"
    role: "Agent self-reflection 代表工作"
    key_finding: "通过 verbal feedback 强化 agent，反思文本存入 episodic memory 用于后续 trial"
    our_differentiation: "Reflexion 是 agent 自我改进机制，我们是外部 monitoring；self-reflection 可能失效时我们的 monitor 仍能检测 stagnation"

  - id: "zhou2024lats"
    title: "Language Agent Tree Search Unifies Reasoning, Acting, and Planning in Language Models"
    authors: "Andy Zhou, Kai Yan, Michal Shlapentokh-Rothman, Haohan Wang, Yu-Xiong Wang"
    venue: "ICML 2024"
    year: 2024
    arxiv: "2310.04406"
    category: "background"
    role: "Agent planning + self-reflection"
    key_finding: "结合 MCTS 与 LM value function 和 self-reflection，支持 backtracking"
    our_differentiation: "LATS 通过搜索避免 stagnation，但计算开销大；我们的 monitor 可作为 LATS 的早期终止信号"

  - id: "yao2023tot"
    title: "Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models"
    authors: "Shunyu Yao, Dian Yu, Jeffrey Zhao, Izhak Shafran, Thomas L. Griffiths, Yuan Cao, Karthik Narasimhan"
    venue: "NeurIPS 2023"
    year: 2023
    arxiv: "2305.10601"
    category: "background"
    role: "Deliberate reasoning 框架"
    key_finding: "将 CoT 泛化为树结构，LM 自我评估中间 thought 并 backtrack"
    our_differentiation: "ToT 的自评估是 single-step 的；我们捕捉 multi-step temporal patterns"

  - id: "cemri2025multiagentfail"
    title: "Why Do Multi-Agent LLM Systems Fail?"
    authors: "Mert Cemri, Melissa Z. Pan, Shuyi Yang, Lakshya A. Agrawal, et al."
    venue: "arXiv preprint"
    year: 2025
    arxiv: "2503.13657"
